# CoreLink security.txt — RFC 9116 compliant
# Validate at: https://securitytxt.org/  and  https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9116
#
# This file is served at https://corelink-docs.humangr.com/.well-known/security.txt
# (Docusaurus copies /static/.well-known/* as-is during build.)
#
# No PGP key is published at this time; the Encryption field is omitted
# rather than pointing at a key that does not exist. This file remains
# canonical per RFC 9116 §2.3 (Canonical field).
#
# Exactly one Contact address is listed, and it is the one with an explicit
# Cloudflare Email Routing rule (verified: security@ -> forward, priority 10,
# ahead of the catch-all). A second address was removed rather than left
# unrouted: an unrouted address in the canonical disclosure file silently
# swallows the report it invites.

Contact: mailto:security@humangr.com
Expires: 2027-05-14T00:00:00.000Z
Acknowledgments: https://corelink-docs.humangr.com/security/hall-of-fame
Preferred-Languages: en, pt-BR, es
Canonical: https://corelink-docs.humangr.com/.well-known/security.txt
Policy: https://corelink-docs.humangr.com/security/policy

# Trust Center — public-facing compliance / data-handling / sub-processors /
# incident-response posture. trust@ is the procurement + DPA + auditor
# contact; security@ remains the vulnerability-disclosure contact.
# https://corelink-docs.humangr.com/trust

# Notes for parsers:
#  - Expires MUST be a single ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC ("Z"). One year out
#    is the recommended cadence (RFC 9116 §2.5.5). Renew before expiry.
#  - Multiple Contact lines are allowed and listed in priority order.
#  - Preferred-Languages uses BCP 47 tags; "pt-BR" is the canonical Brazilian
#    Portuguese subtag.
#  - The plain-text file MUST be served with Content-Type: text/plain;
#    charset=utf-8 (handled by Docusaurus default static asset middleware).
